Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Aurora Retail evaluation

Hi Sophie & Raj,

Thanks for taking the time on today's call — great conversation and some clear alignment on use cases (product search relevance + category-level personalization). Quick recap and a few asks so we can accelerate procurement/security cycles: 

Recap:
- Primary pilot: search relevance improvement across web + mobile (Q3 pilot).
- Target metric: +6-8% CTR on top-3 results, measured via A/B over 8 weeks.
- Runtime needs: ~400 reqs/sec peak, p95 latency target <150ms.

Asks / next steps:
1) Could you share a short org chart (or a list) of decision-makers and reviewers for this initiative? Specifically looking for: economic buyer, procurement contact, legal lead for contracts, and security/compliance reviewers.
2) Any firm timelines around procurement/contracting (target decision date)?
3) Any required security documentation or questionnaire we should complete early (SOC2, data residency, vendor risk form)?
4) We'll put together a short pilot proposal (SOW + pricing) and a security questionnaire answer set — target to send by Thursday EOD.

I've attached meeting-notes-20260714.pdf from our call. If it's helpful, Rishi can run a brief technical deep-dive next week to bring your infra/security folks up to speed.

Proposed next meeting: 30-min technical sync — Tue Jul 21 or Wed Jul 22. Let me know which works for your team.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: meeting-notes-20260714.pdf

- Economic buyer: Raj Patel, SVP of Retail Ops (he is looped here)
- Procurement: Lina Gomez (procurement@auroraretail.com) — not on this thread yet
- Legal: Tom Whitaker, Legal Counsel (contracts@auroraretail.com)
- Security reviewer: security@auroraretail.com (we've copied them on vendor intake)

On timeline, Raj is looking to have vendor shortlist by end of July and decision in mid-August. We have a standard vendor security questionnaire — attaching our intake form separately. We should be able to share Lina and Tom for introductions once we have a short SOW/quote.

Also curious on ballpark pricing for the pilot (expected monthly token/usage estimate). If you can include a sample quote that will help speed approvals.

On the technical sync, Tue Jul 21 afternoon works for Raj and our infra folks.

Best,
Sophie
